items.title: Give any website a WebMCP interface
items.summary: Today we are launching a developer preview of WebMCP on Cloudflare. Switch it on and browser agents can start working with your site, with no code and nothing changed at your origin. Cloudflare adds a small bridge to your pages, which registers a set of tools for a visitor’s agent to use. The web was built on the assumption that there is a person on the other end: someone to read the page, click buttons, and fill in
items.summaryZh: Cloudflare推出了WebMCP的开发者预览版，旨在通过标准化接口让AI Agent能够直接与网页交互，无需通过传统的爬虫抓取。WebMCP作为一种新的浏览器标准，允许网站暴露特定工具供Agent调用，从而提升Agent的浏览体验和任务执行效率。Cloudflare通过提供一键式配置，降低了开发者实现该标准的门槛，推动了Agentic Internet的发展。

items.title: The next generation of MCP
items.summary: Over the last year and a half, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the universal standard for how agents interact with external services. But one of the main criticisms of MCP was that the protocol required a stateful connection between Client and Server. This evolved from MCP’s origins and the first STDIO transport, designed for local applications . When MCP Servers went remote, it translated the stateful co
items.summaryZh: Cloudflare宣布MCP（Model Context Protocol）协议已升级为完全无状态（Stateless）架构。此前的MCP协议依赖有状态连接，导致部署复杂且成本高昂。新版规范及配套SDK简化了请求路由和会话管理，使得MCP服务器可以直接在无服务器环境（如Cloudflare Workers）中运行，极大提升了开发者的运维效率和系统的可扩展性。

items.title: Introducing Kitesurf: The agent-first browser that runs in V8 isolates on Cloudflare Workers
items.summary: Should we build our own browser? This is one of those questions that has come up every few months internally at Cloudflare for years. Unsurprisingly, it’s the kind that triggers long threads with multiple reasons and persuasive arguments on why we should do it. The browser is obviously the most important software we use every day on our computers; it’s arguably the operating system of the Internet. We’re a company on
items.summaryZh: Cloudflare发布了Kitesurf，这是一个专为AI Agent设计的浏览器架构，运行在V8隔离环境及Cloudflare Workers之上。针对传统浏览器（如Chromium）为人类设计、资源占用过高的问题，Kitesurf通过利用WebAssembly (Wasm) 和高性能边缘计算，为Agent提供更轻量、低成本的自动化环境。该方案旨在解决AI Agent在执行复杂网页任务时面临的内存与计算瓶颈，是边缘计算与Agent技术结合的重要探索。

items.title: Building an open Agentic Internet: readable, discoverable, callable, and payable
items.summary: Our data shows that a lot of traffic from well-behaved bots is re-fetching pages that have not changed . Billions of requests. An enormous amount of machine effort, attached to no outcome at all. That's the signature of a web built for humans being visited by something else. Agents are here - not as a new kind of software, but as a new kind of visitor to the web. The web reshaped around this new visitor is what we ca
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了“Agentic Internet”的概念，指出AI Agent已成为互联网流量的重要组成部分。Cloudflare认为未来的互联网应具备可读、可发现、可调用和可支付的特性，以适应Agent的自动化访问需求，而非仅仅服务于人类用户。
